title: Senior technicians are the only knowledge base

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: Juniors call seniors while both are on jobs. Manuals and old notes are scattered across folders and chat. A recurring school printer configuration is repeatedly rediscovered. End-of-day notes just say fixed, and seniors worry about procedures being applied without their exceptions.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: 13 staff; two long-serving technicians carry most customer-specific knowledge.

discriminating_questions.question: Is the fix general or site-specific?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: It depends on the school’s print-server configuration.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: If the problem requires specialist judgement or physical experience, documents may reduce interruptions but cannot replace training.

discriminating_questions.question: Do notes describe applicability?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: They rarely include software version or prerequisites.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Who approves knowledge entries?
discriminating_questions.diagnostic_value: Unreviewed notes cannot become authoritative procedures.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Can capture happen during work?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Short dictated notes are feasible; long forms are not.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: Resolution context is not captured, scoped, reviewed or retired, so experience cannot transfer reliably.
counterexample: If the problem requires specialist judgement or physical experience, documents may reduce interruptions but cannot replace training.
minimum_evidence: A simulated ticket sequence repeats the same configuration issue.
A simulated folder contains obsolete instructions.
A simulated senior review identifies a missing version prerequisite.
process_intervention: Capture symptoms, environment, tests, result and exceptions; assign review owners and retirement dates.
automation_candidate: Draft knowledge articles from redacted job notes; retrieve by environment and scope; show sources and review status to technicians.
unknowns: Actual solution accuracy requires expert review; synthetic procedures must never become device repair authority.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Reviewed technical knowledge management and retrieval need a dedicated extension.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
